name: When is the best time of year to start bathroom addition framing in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: When is the best time of year to start bathroom addition framing in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best time of year to start bathroom addition framing in the Bay Area, including areas like Daly City and San Bruno, is typically during the drier months, from late spring through early fall (roughly May to October). This period minimizes potential delays due to heavy rains, which can affect excavation, foundation work, and the structural lumber. While indoor work can proceed year-round, starting with more favorable weather for the exterior shell and framing can help keep your project on schedule and protect materials from moisture damage during construction.
acceptedAnswer.description: The best time for bathroom addition framing in the Bay Area is generally late spring through early fall (May-October). This avoids heavy rains, which can delay excavation and protect materials.
